name: photo-wiki
description: Answers from the photos you saved in Photo Wiki and the notes you added about who was involved and why.

interface.longDescription: Your AI can't see your camera roll. Photo Wiki lets it. Pick photos and screenshots in the Photo Wiki iPhone app, add a word about who or why, and ask: where am I working Friday, where did I see that watch, what did I do on day two in Rome. ChatGPT answers from what is in the photos and your notes, shows the photos themselves, saves what you mention back onto the photo, and keeps wiki pages for your trips, people and topics. Only the photos you pick are uploaded, as downscaled copies; your data is not used to train AI models.
defaultPrompt: What did I do in Florence?
Show me the watch my wife wants.

positive.prompt: What did I do in Florence?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the 'Italy trip, autumn 2026' page and says Sep 30 was a hillside garden with old stone steps, the first stop of the trip, with the cited photos shown as a gallery.

positive.description: Find a fact in a photo's notes
positive.prompt: How heavy was my suitcase on the flight home from Rome?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers 22.6 kg against a 23 kg limit, at Fiumicino check-in, from the note on the baggage scale photo.

positive.prompt: Show me the watch my wife wants.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the watch photo in the Photo Wiki gallery and says it was tried on at a department store in Samseong-dong, Seoul, in May, as a birthday idea. No images from the web.

positive.description: Save a note the user mentions
positive.prompt: Remember that the Korean dinner was a delivery on a rainy night.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the dinner photo and appends the note to it, then confirms.
Finds the one photo not on any page (the dinner) and files it into a new or existing page, citing its id.

negative.description: Editing an image is not about the user's saved memories
negative.prompt: Remove the background from this photo.

negative.description: Finding images on the web, not the user's own photos
negative.prompt: Find free photos of Rome I can use in a presentation.
What camera is good for travel photos?

review.commerce_description: Photo Wiki does not sell anything or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: search photos and notes, show photos in a gallery, save notes from the conversation, and read and write wiki pages.

ko-KR.subtitle: 저장한 사진으로 답해요
ko-KR.description: 당신의 AI는 사진첩을 못 봐요. Photo Wiki가 보여 줘요. Photo Wiki 아이폰 앱에서 사진과 스크린샷을 고르고 누구와, 왜를 한마디 남겨 두면, 이렇게 물어볼 수 있어요: 모레 근무지 어디였지, 사려고 찍어 둔 시계 어디서 봤지, 로마 둘째 날에 뭐 했지. ChatGPT가 사진 속 내용과 내 메모로 답하고, 사진을 직접 보여 주고, 대화에서 나온 말을 사진에 메모로 남기고, 여행·사람·주제별 위키 페이지를 정리해요. 내가 고른 사진만 줄인 사본으로 올라가고, 내 데이터는 AI 학습에 쓰이지 않아요.
